body: ปุ่มเล็กๆ จะลอยอยู่เหนือแอปอื่น แตะปุ่มนี้เมื่อดูโพสต์หางาน แชท หรือประกาศ แล้ว SafeRoute จะตรวจสอบสิ่งที่อยู่บนหน้าจอของคุณ

messageGuard.title: Message Guard: warns you about risky messages as they arrive
messageGuard.privacy: Only messages that look risky are checked. Codes and personal numbers are removed first.

status.web: Works in the SafeRoute Android app.
status.on: On. Risky messages from your chat and SMS apps get a warning.
status.needsAccess: Off. Turning it on opens Android notification access.

errors.accessOff: Notification access is still off. If the switch is greyed out, open SafeRoute in App info, tap the three dots and choose "Allow restricted settings".
errors.cannotOpen: Could not open the notification access settings.
